title: FDA Records Request: Chopped Romaine, Five Line 2 Lots

fields.agency: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Office of Inspections and Investigations, Pacific Region
fields.firm: Pinecrest Fresh Cut, LLC, Plant 1, Salinas, California (FEI on file)
fields.reason: FDA is working with the California Department of Public Health on an investigation into reported E. coli O157:H7 illnesses. Some of the people who became ill report eating bagged chopped romaine. FDA understands that your firm has a presumptive positive result on a retained sample of chopped romaine.
recordsRequested: Shipping records for each finished-product traceability lot code above. Include the traceability lot code, product description, quantity and unit of measure, ship date, ship-from location, ship-to location and reference document (for example, the bill of lading number).

Receiving records for the incoming romaine from Santa Lucia Growers Ranch 14, Block C, that went into these lots. Include the grower's lot code as it appears on the harvest ticket, product, quantity and unit of measure, grower location, harvest date, receive date and reference document.
Transformation records that link that incoming lot to each finished-product traceability lot code it went into, with production dates and quantities.
Shipping and receiving records from your distribution centers and from any co-packer or distributor that received these lots, down to each ship-to location.
The name, phone number and email address of a point of contact at your firm for this request, and confirmation that you received it.
fields.format: One electronic sortable spreadsheet (.xlsx or .csv), with one row per shipment, sent by email to the contact below. If any records are kept only on paper, tell us which ones and when you expect to send them.
fields.signature: R. Delgado, Supervisory Investigator, Office of Inspections and Investigations, Pacific Region

instructorNote: This letter starts FDA's 24-hour records clock (due 07:34 Wednesday). TRACE should confirm receipt and name a point of contact quickly without dropping the 4-hour trace target, and RECALL should log the receipt time and check that the reviewed sheet to FDA matches the CDPH list, including the 60-case gap and the Rivermark paper records on a gaps tab.
